sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-handoff-audit/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 31 (quality number 30), Internal Quality Checks row 31; no extra populated annotation/comment for this row
evidence: The workbook row requires a matching successful case for every negative check; quality-checks.md:128 expressly requires it inside the same criterion. Most functional controls are explicit: task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:308 requires each refusing tier actor's own success; :326 pairs self-refusal with another successful approval by that actor and successful approval of the same target by another actor; :551-569 pair stale refusals with actual successful operations; :632-677 pair every anonymous family with authenticated success. The remaining bounded gap is task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:140 (hro_pol_loading): "pending state is readable and interface does not falsely present completion" is the natural observation bar, while "then release it and verify successful completion" is only inside the "If naturally too fast" throttling/delay branch. No successful completion is specified for naturally visible pending operations. task/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:6 requires only a usable saved record as global gate and independent scoring; :14 covers releasing an artificially delayed response, not naturally stalled operations. Thus those instructions do not provide the missing matching control. Public instruction.md:13 asks for readable loading states. A conforming fast operation remains testable via the permitted unchanged delay, without any required spinner or minimum duration; no corresponding false-negative demand was found. The five cited task source hashes match the evidence index, including polish judge db23c3a44d06f718e0661a9f6bb8d25eb9508a5a09807902ef3f9554a0e8877e and prompt c1b99fea66673d61cdf8084434b8c64765aa95029d2e82144cd93243d5711465. Verified local/ui/results.json SHA256 0b8cf0734fdd1f3bf5a503c997970550fd799bc88b869d03e95833d89b461ba7 and ui-run.log SHA256 999205f7625e048b929b21bb04603fb346a5753b68565fd90de1cb25218d21b9: the 16 scripted checks include successful recovery but no loading/stalled-request witness. This is a criterion-source finding, not an observed configured judge score or a golden loading defect.
counterexample: A submission can implement login, requisition/offer creation and saved-record readback correctly (so the Polish gate succeeds), but leave a dedicated revision request permanently pending while displaying a readable Saving message and never claiming completion. A reviewer who observes this naturally outstanding save satisfies hro_pol_loading's unconditional text, never enters its fast-response branch, and has no instructed successful completion to observe. The dead revision transport can therefore receive loading credit even while its separately scored operation fails. This is a concrete source-level counterexample; no new runtime mutation or provider judge was run.
suggested_fix: Make successful completion/readback of the same observed load/save mandatory for both naturally visible and deliberately delayed pending-state probes, reusing an existing matching successful observation if appropriate and continuing to report evaluator/tool limitations separately.
